extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: triple-fan graphics card (2.5 slot), approx. 300 x 140 x 52 mm
extras.notes: lies on its backplate with the fans facing up; PCIe x16 gold contact edge faces +Y, top edge with heat pipe bends, RGB strip and two 8-pin power sockets faces -Y, slot bracket with three DisplayPort and one HDMI socket at +X. Movable: fan rotors 'graphics-card_fan_1_rotor' to '_3_rotor' (origin at each hub, spin around Z). Static part 'graphics-card_fins' = aluminium fin block. No text, no logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
